question: What is your best petty revenge story?
story: My neighbor reported my garden to the city, so I spent the next spring turning my entire yard into a legal loophole. He complained that my sunflowers were, in his words, an eyesore blocking his view. The city agreed and made me cut every one of them down. So I read the ordinance. All of it. Twice. It turned out the height limit only applied to ornamental plants. Vegetables were exempt, because the town passed a food garden protection rule in the nineties that nobody had touched since. So I planted corn. Sixty stalks, in a perfectly straight line, exactly along the property line, and every single one of them legal. Here is the best part. He called the city again. The inspector came out, measured, and told him it was protected. Then the inspector turned around and asked me for an ear of corn. I gave him two.
